name: Kyle Kulinski
role: American progressive political commentator (Secular Talk, Kyle & Krystal); co-founder of Justice Democrats
summary: Kulinski describes himself as a social democrat, wanting Scandinavian-style welfare, public ownership of utilities, single-payer health care and heavy taxes on the rich, while rejecting full socialisation and revolution. He is a civil libertarian, opposes US offensive wars and corporate money in politics, and supports a nation state with borders and a humanitarian immigration process.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Strongly agreed with 'I support single-payer universal healthcare' in the 8 Values quiz.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Said government intervention is not a threat to the economy as a principle and that lack of intervention is the bigger threat; he also rejected the item that freer markets mean freer people.

public-ownership.rationale: Strongly agreed that basic utilities like roads and electricity should be publicly owned.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Strongly agreed that taxes should be increased on the rich to provide for the poor.

unions-good.rationale: Said trade unionism is still viable and necessary and must be uncorrupted rather than abandoned.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Strongly agreed that government must intervene to protect consumers and that environmental regulations are essential, and said corporations control the government.

cut-welfare.rationale: Strongly disagreed that it is better to keep a balanced budget than to ensure welfare for all citizens, and that social programs should be abolished for private charity.

worker-ownership.rationale: Wants more worker co-ops and incentives for them but would not make every company worker-owned: 'in some instances yes, in some no'.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Strongly rejected trading civil liberties for anti-terror security but disagreed that surveillance is unnecessary (taking it to mean illegal spying), so the evidence points both ways.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Strongly agreed that drug use should be legalized or decriminalized.

strong-leader.rationale: Disagreed that the stronger the leadership the better, calling it authoritarian rule that overrides everything.

state-harmful.rationale: Disagreed that the existence of the state is a threat to liberty and said nation states are almost necessary to organize society.

limit-guns.rationale: Agreed there should be a process restricting who gets guns, while saying he would not ban all guns.

empower-police-military.rationale: Said the US spends far too much on the military versus infrastructure, education and health care; nothing found on police funding.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Strongly disagreed that prostitution should be illegal.

decide-locally.rationale: Said sometimes he wants national government to act and sometimes state or local, and answered neutral.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Strongly agreed that same-sex marriage should be legal.

abortion-legal.rationale: Disagreed in both quizzes that abortion should be prohibited or banned.

more-religion-public.rationale: Strongly disagreed that religion should play a role in the government.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Generally agreed that policies enabling mass immigration are naive, while also saying he wants a humanitarian immigration process.

free-trade.rationale: Said the free-trade consensus is a neoliberal default and that intelligent tariffs are a useful tool.

nation-first.rationale: Wants to take care of Americans first on aid but also said government must be accountable to international law and that foreign interests should not be put above one's own group; mixed.

open-borders.rationale: Said he does not want totally open borders and wants borders with a reasonable humanitarian process.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Called climate change one of the greatest threats and agreed all socialists must fiercely combat it and that a united world is needed, but said measures must not cut quality of life.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Went neutral on whether a better world will come from automation, science and technology: it could improve or worsen things.

revolution-justified.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-12): the old wording asked whether revolution is sometimes justified, and this disagreement rested on a preference for reform or lawful means, which doesn't say revolution is never justified.

reviewHistory.rationale: Disagreed that revolution is the best way and that revolutionary violence is acceptable for a good outcome, but stayed neutral on a violent uprising by the oppressed after all options are exhausted.

central-planning.rationale: Disagreed that a centrally planned economy is the best route in underdeveloped societies and said he does not want a totally centrally planned economy.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Kind of disagreed that inheritance is a legitimate form of wealth and said it should be taxed 'like crazy', allowing only a few million.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Agreed that tariffs are important to encourage local production, if done intelligently.

one-party-rule.rationale: Said socialist parties should compete in liberal democratic elections and rejected a single party leading the global socialist movement.

direct-votes.rationale: Said he believes in direct democracy and democracy more broadly, within a constitution that takes some things off the table.

workers-councils.rationale: Said socialist parties should take part in liberal democratic elections and that party politics remains relevant.

political-violence-never.rationale: Believes in non-violence as far as possible but accepts violence in self-defence and went neutral on violent uprising against oppression.

separate-church-state.rationale: Strongly disagreed that religion should play a role in the government and agreed churches should be taxed like other institutions.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Strongly disagreed that religion should play a role in the government, which excludes basing law on scripture.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Called diversity a colossal strength of a nation and favours a melting-pot multiculturalism.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Agreed class conflict has influenced much of human history ('undeniable'), though the statement says main driving force.

limit-population.rationale: Rejected curbing population growth to prevent ecological disaster as 'very Malthusian'.

restore-past-order.rationale: Disagreed that society was better many years ago and that past traditions must be kept, though he also said chasing progress at all costs is dangerous.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Called himself an empiricist who wants to copy what empirically works, such as Scandinavian social democracy.

means-match-ends.rationale: Said the ends do not justify the means and one should be against violence in a principled way.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Disagreed that humanity must return to primitive ways of the past to overcome climate issues.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Disagreed with 'from each according to his ability to each according to his need', saying he favours meritocracy and competition more than most leftists.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Answered no to the dictatorship of the proletariat being necessary as a transition.

collective-farming.rationale: Said not all factories and farms need to be publicly owned and he would not ban private farms.

taxation-theft.rationale: Strongly agrees taxes should be raised on the rich and wants publicly funded services.

total-state.rationale: Disagreed with a hierarchical state and said he wants only certain things centrally planned.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Said most US wars are illegal offensive wars not needed for defence and that international law should be followed.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Wants the workplace made more of a democracy and agreed workplace democracy and self-management are desirable, though not for every firm.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Strongly disagreed that a balanced budget is better than ensuring welfare for all citizens.

national-self-determination.rationale: Agreed that national liberation or self-determination for all peoples is a good concept.

force-without-un.rationale: Disagreed that wars need not be justified to other countries, saying international law should be followed on the world stage.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Said traditional gender roles such as women as homemakers must be overcome and women should do whatever they want.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Agreed all people regardless of culture or sexuality should be treated equally.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Said the state has a monopoly on violence but disagreed that it is a monopoly on oppression.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Said everybody should assimilate into a melting pot but also that diversity is a strength; no demand to give up one's culture.

national-mission.rationale: Disagreed that the nation's values should be spread, calling it code for more military interventions.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Said the government is massively corrupt and called establishment Democrats 'Republican-lite' with the party 'a shell of its former self'.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Strongly agreed government must intervene in the economy and that utilities should be public.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Agreed all people should be treated equally and called diversity a strength.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Answered 'yeah, of course' to all people regardless of culture or sexuality being treated equally.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Said violence is only acceptable for self-defence and the ends do not justify the means.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Said diversity is a colossal strength of a nation, giving different people a voice and role.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Strongly disagreed that civil liberties may be sacrificed against terrorism: rights are off the table by definition.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Went neutral on regional unions like the EU: exploitative in some ways yet he supports national sovereignty and international law.

clerical-rule.rationale: Strongly disagreed that religion should play a role in the government, which excludes clerics holding supreme authority.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Went neutral: no culture is superior as a claim, but some are better on measurable metrics such as Scandinavian health care.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Said civil liberties are off the table and cannot be traded away.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Neutral on international aid and on sacrificing home resources: would pay to stop starvation but puts his own country first.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Wants taxes on the rich increased to provide for the poor, a progressive structure.

women-must-cover.rationale: Said women should be able to do whatever they want and traditional gender roles need to be overcome.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Agreed that material conditions and needs are the dominant drive behind socioeconomic change.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Said government should not follow the majority where constitutional rights are concerned; a majority cannot vote away rights.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Said a revolution would be lost, would fail quickly, and that violence is acceptable only in self-defence.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Said claims of cultural superiority have been used for ugly ends and condemned illegal offensive wars.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Agreed that capitalism will induce its own demise through crisis contradictions and said Marx was 'pretty much spot on'.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Said a constitution should take rights off the table so a majority cannot vote them away.

corporate-influence.rationale: Said corporations control the government and urged getting rid of corporate money in politics.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Disagreed that marriage is a patriarchal construct to be phased out: if people want it, let them.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Agreed government should be accountable to the international community and that international law should exist and be obeyed.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Said oppression of LGBTQ people is a major issue to be seriously addressed, and strongly supports same-sex marriage.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Said civil liberties and rights are off the table, and called authoritarian override unacceptable.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Wants more workplace democracy and said he believes in direct democracy.

assisted-dying.rationale: Strongly agreed that physician-assisted suicide should be legal.

social-market-economy.rationale: Wants Scandinavian-style social democracy, a market economy with strong social protection.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Said he is in favour of having a military even though he thinks spending is far too high.

racial-franchise.rationale: Agreed all people should be treated equally.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Said corporations control the government and that world government would be run by billionaires and oligarchs; backs getting corporate money out.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its rationale is about prisons or punishment, and the statement now asks only whether the police should be abolished.

reviewHistory.rationale: Disagreed that prisons should be abolished, calling that utopian and silly for violent crime.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Strongly disagreed that social programs should be abolished in favour of private charity.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Said he believes in the right to self-defence and that violence is justified for self-defence.

free-public-college.rationale: Strongly agreed quality education is a right for all people, and named free college among policies Justice Democrats candidates back.

future-generations.rationale: Agreed we must think long term beyond our lifespans for our children and grandchildren.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Rejected burn-it-all-down in favour of a hostile takeover of existing institutions, and agreed liberal democracy is a viable route.

premarital-sex.rationale: Disagreed that sex outside of marriage is immoral.

women-suffrage.rationale: Agreed all people should be treated equally and that women should be able to do whatever they want.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: Said rights and civil liberties cannot be taken off the table, which rules out state killing without trial.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: Strongly disagreed that those who can pay more should get better care: everyone should get the same high-quality health care.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Disagreed that nationalism and patriotism are unacceptable in a socialist society; loves his country and wants to improve it.

decent-living-guarantee.rationale: Strongly disagreed that it is better to keep a balanced budget than to ensure welfare for all citizens, and that social programs should be abolished for private charity. (Carried over from cut-welfare, "Welfare programs create dependency and should be cut.", with the value reversed, 2026-11-11.)

notes: Rests mostly on two quizzes he took on camera in the same period (8 Values and Left Values); where a quiz item only partly matches a statement the answer is medium. Searched themes outside the quizzes (Israel, Ukraine, courts, elections, trans issues, free speech): his own words were not available in sources opened, so those stay null. Wikipedia reports he later called Israel's Gaza war a genocide and supported campus protests; the cited articles did not carry his own words, so not used.
